specs.mechanism: a starter who leans on one pitch, against a lineup that hits that pitch, has nowhere to hide for eighteen outs; the market prices his season line, not tonight's specific collision

specs.mechanism: a top-heavy order with the platoon advantage concentrates its best bats where the extra plate appearances go; club-level pricing averages that concentration away
specs.name: stacked_top_platoon

specs.mechanism: the classic exploitation: a one-handed lineup built against a starter with a genuine platoon split; V1 tested each half alone and found nothing -- the claim here is the product, not either part
specs.name: platoon_pressure

specs.mechanism: the concentrated top of the order specifically hits the opposing starter's primary pitch
specs.name: stacked_top_vs_pitch

specs.mechanism: a lineup one-handed on purpose AND good against the starter's main offering -- two independent reads of 'built for this starter' agreeing
specs.name: handed_lineup_vs_pitch

specs.mechanism: the best bats, concentrated, against a starter with a real measured weakness
